entries.originalText: “My Son, be not curious, nor trouble thyself with vain cares.
entries.modernizedText: “My Son, do not be curious, or trouble yourself with vain cares.

entries.originalText: Follow thou Me.(1) For what is it to thee whether a man be this or that, or say or do thus or thus?
entries.modernizedText: Follow Me.(1) For what is it to you whether a man is this or that, or says or does this or that?

entries.originalText: Thou hast no need to answer for others, but thou must give an answer for thyself.
entries.modernizedText: You have no need to answer for others, but you must give an answer for yourself.

entries.originalText: Why therefore dost thou entangle thyself?
entries.modernizedText: Why therefore do you entangle yourself?

entries.originalText: Behold, I know all men, and I behold all things which are done under the sun; and I know how it standeth with each one, what he thinketh, what he willeth, and to what end his thoughts reach.
entries.modernizedText: Behold, I know all men, and I behold all things that are done under the sun; and I know how it stands with each one, what he thinks, what he wills, and to what end his thoughts reach.

entries.originalText: All things therefore are to be committed to Me; watch thou thyself in godly peace, and leave him who is unquiet to be unquiet as he will.
entries.modernizedText: All things therefore are to be committed to Me; watch yourself in godly peace, and leave him who is unquiet to be unquiet as he will.

entries.originalText: Whatsoever he shall do or say, shall come unto him, for he cannot deceive Me.
entries.modernizedText: Whatever he does or says will come upon him, for he cannot deceive Me.

entries.originalText: “Trouble not thyself about the shadow of a great name, nor about the friendship of many, nor about the love of men towards thee.
entries.modernizedText: “Do not trouble yourself about the shadow of a great name, or about the friendship of many, or about the love of men toward you.

entries.originalText: For these things beget distraction and great sorrows of heart.
entries.modernizedText: For these things beget distraction and great sorrows of heart.

entries.originalText: My word should speak freely unto thee, and I would reveal secrets, if only thou didst diligently look for My appearing, and didst open unto Me the gates of thy heart.
entries.modernizedText: My word would speak freely to you, and I would reveal secrets, if only you diligently looked for My appearing, and opened to Me the gates of your heart.

entries.originalText: Be sober and watch unto prayer,(2) and humble thyself in all things.”
entries.modernizedText: Be sober and watch in prayer,(2) and humble yourself in all things.”
